harness.name: forefy/.context
harness.description: AI agent skills for security audits, pentests and bug bounty work, from recon to PoC generation.

uses.quote: `pre-bounty` - pre-engagement recon and target prioritization for a bounty/VDP scope; maps assets, mines bug history, extracts scope gotchas, then scores and ranks every asset best-to-worst by opportunity and renders a ranked asset -> setup -> ROI Sankey.

`jwt-attacks` - forges and re-signs captured JWTs to test signature validation (alg:none, signature stripping, kid traversal, jwk/jku injection, RS256/HS256 confusion) plus offline HMAC secret cracking.
`foundry-poc` - context-window-optimized skill to generate a Foundry proof of concept for a discussed finding.
